scripts.build: npm run build -w @cwp/shared && npm run build -w @cwp/database && npm run build -w @cwp/api && npm run build -w @cwp/web
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @cwp/shared && npm run build -w @cwp/database
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cwp/api" "npm run dev -w @cwp/web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run licenses:check && npm audit --omit=dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cwp/shared && npm run build -w @cwp/database && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
